name: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - The Sith Lords
description: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - The Sith Lords is a singleplayer third-person role-playing game and the second in the Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic series.

steam.rollback_steps: Steam beta branch 'legacypc' reverts to the pre-patch build with EAX intact (right-click the game -> Properties -> Betas).
steam.store_details: Steam installs Aspyr's 2015 update by default, which has no EAX. The original is on the 'legacypc' beta branch.

gog.rollback_steps: In Heroic, open Modify Installation, then on the Game Version tab tick "Keep the game at specific version" and choose Version 1.0b (2019).
gog.store_details: GOG's default install is Aspyr's May 2022 update, which has no EAX. The original is the older Version 1.0b from 2019.

eax.problem: The original release used DirectSound3D. An update replaced it with a newer audio engine that has no EAX.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in KOTOR II's configuration.

sources.title: Pocket Gamer: Knights of the Old Republic II updated on Steam by team who brought original to mobile
